app_info.subtitle: Track prices and price drops
app_info.description: DipCatch helps users track products across shops, compare current prices, review price history, and set alerts for price drops or target prices.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves products in the signed-in user's DipCatch account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one product and its tracked shops from the signed-in user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a shop page for preview and creates a private tracked product only after the user confirms the draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool reads shop pages but only creates data in the signed-in user's private DipCatch account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new product and does not delete or irreversibly alter existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a shop page for preview and adds a private tracked shop only after the user confirms the draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool reads shop pages but only changes the signed-in user's private DipCatch account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a shop without deleting or irreversibly altering existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches tracked shop pages and refreshes private price and stock records in the signed-in user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads retailer pages and updates private DipCatch data without changing external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Records new check results while retaining price history and does not delete user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes a tracked shop and recalculates the product's cheapest shop.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes data in the signed-in user's private DipCatch account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deletes the selected tracked shop from the user's account.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the selected product's private price-alert settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes settings in the signed-in user's private DipCatch account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the selected stored alert values.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves retained price-history segments for one product in the signed-in user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a product and its tracked price data from the signed-in user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes data in the signed-in user's private DipCatch account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes the selected product, its shops, and its price history.

test_cases.description: List tracked products and inspect one product's details and price history.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my tracked products, then show the shop prices and price history for the coffee beans.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the user's matching products, current shop prices, cheapest option, and dated price-history segments.

test_cases.description: Preview and confirm a new product from a retailer URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Track this coffee product: https://example.com/coffee. Show the detected details first, and add it only after I confirm.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the detected product details and asks for confirmation before creating the private tracked product.

test_cases.description: Preview and confirm a second retailer for an existing product.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add this retailer page to my coffee product. Show what it found before saving it: https://example.com/coffee-alt.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the detected shop details and adds the shop only after confirmation.

test_cases.user_prompt: The price for my coffee product looks old. Recheck every tracked shop now.
test_cases.expected_output: Refreshes available shops and returns the updated price, stock, and any shops skipped by the page budget.

test_cases.description: Change alerts and remove unneeded tracked data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Alert me when my coffee reaches 8 euros, remove the old retailer, and delete the discontinued product after I confirm it.
test_cases.expected_output: After confirmation, updates the requested alert, removes the named shop, and deletes the product.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a general shopping recommendation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What are the best coffee beans to buy this month?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not concern the user's tracked products.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for public price reporting outside the user's account.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Publish the current coffee price on my social media account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot publish content or manage social media accounts.
